user.title: CPAP Local Setup
user.description: Choose how to connect to your CPAP device's SD card.

http.title: HTTP Connection (WiFi SD Card)
http.description: Connect via a WiFi SD card adapter such as EZ Share. Ensure your CPAP is off and the adapter is powered and accessible.

local.title: Local Mounted Path
local.description: Connect to a locally mounted SD card or network share that exposes the CPAP SD card files.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Make sure your CPAP is off and your device is connected to its WiFi network. Submit again to save anyway.
error.invalid_path: The specified path does not exist or is not readable.
